tables.name: source_documents
tables.table:
CREATE TABLE source_documents (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	canonical_url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	publisher VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	retrieved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	event_name VARCHAR(200), 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	pages JSON NOT NULL, 
	image_urls JSON NOT NULL, 
	rights TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (canonical_url, content_hash)
)

tables.name: upgrade_candidates
tables.table:
CREATE TABLE upgrade_candidates (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	team_key VARCHAR(40), 
	season INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	component VARCHAR(60), 
	event_name VARCHAR(200), 
	observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	supporting_passage TEXT NOT NULL, 
	page INTEGER, 
	evidence_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	representation VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	review_notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	legacy_upgrade_id UUID, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('draft','approved','rejected')), 
	CHECK (representation IN ('annotation_only','modeled')), 
	CHECK (evidence_status IN ('unverified','reported','confirmed','conflicting')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES source_documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(legacy_upgrade_id) REFERENCES upgrades (id)
)

tables.name: component_revisions
tables.table:
CREATE TABLE component_revisions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	team_key VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	season INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	component VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	parameters JSON NOT NULL, 
	source_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	uncertainty TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (team_key, season, component, revision_hash)
)

tables.name: car_versions
tables.table:
CREATE TABLE car_versions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	team_key VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	season INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	configuration_event VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	configuration_kind VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'evolution' NOT NULL, 
	reverts_to_id UUID, 
	as_of TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	evidence_cutoff TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	parent_id UUID, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	component_revisions JSON NOT NULL, 
	candidate_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	manifest JSON NOT NULL, 
	visual_review JSON NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('draft','building','ready','published','failed')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reverts_to_id) REFERENCES car_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES car_versions (id)
)

tables.name: release_pointers
tables.table:
CREATE TABLE release_pointers (
	team_key VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	season INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (team_key, season), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version_id) REFERENCES car_versions (id)
)

tables.name: build_jobs
tables.table:
CREATE TABLE build_jobs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version_id UUID, 
	kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	schedule_key VARCHAR(100), 
	parameters JSON NOT NULL, 
	result JSON NOT NULL, 
	error TEXT, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	heartbeat_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('queued','running','succeeded','failed')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version_id) REFERENCES car_versions (id), 
	UNIQUE (schedule_key)
)

tables.name: review_audit
tables.table:
CREATE TABLE review_audit (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	detail JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
